question: In May 2025, Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar inaugurated new sports facilities at a university in Rajgir, located in which district?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nalanda district**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **May 2025**, the Chief Minister of **Bihar**, **Shri Nitish Kumar**, inaugurated the state-of-the-art sports facilities and the administrative wing of the **Bihar Sports University** in **Rajgir**.
 
• **Rajgir** is a prominent historical and pilgrimage city located in the **Nalanda district** of **Bihar**.
 
• The new sports complex is spread over an area of approximately **90 acres** and has been developed with a budget exceeding **Rs. 740 crore** to foster athletic talent in the state.
